Oxygen Cylinder Blast in Delhi's Okhla Injures One

An oxygen cylinder exploded in Delhi's Okhla Phase-1, near a community hall. The fire department received a call about the incident at 10:47 AM. One person was seriously injured and taken to the hospital for treatment. Fire brigade vehicles reached the scene.
